title: The Son of Adam named before creation
summary_md: The Hebrew library's extras-tier witness names the Son of Adam (called *Son of Man* in the inherited canon, restored to *Son of Adam* per Red Line #12) before the sun and stars were made. 1 Enoch 48:2-7 names him in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits before creation. 1 Enoch 62:1 names his enthronement on the throne of glory. 1 Enoch 69:26 names the revelation of his name to the holy ones. The framework reads these passages as the extracanonical confirmation of the Formless-and-Formed nature-of-God reading the framework holds — the Formed pre-existent, the same figure Tanakh theophanies preserved, the same Yahusha (Jesus) of Matt 1:21 announced by name to Yoseph (Joseph) and by apposition *Immanuel — Elohim (God) with us* at Matt 1:23. The name is the gospel; the Hebrew library knew it before the gospel announced it.

title: The plant of righteousness and the Branch
summary_md: 1 Enoch 10:16 — at the close of the Watchers section in the framing of the destruction of all unrighteousness — names *the plant of righteousness and truth* that will appear after the judgment. The framework reads this as the same Messianic-Branch register the prophets walk (Isaiah 11:1's *netser*, Jeremiah 23:5 / 33:15's *tsemach*, Zechariah 3:8 / 6:12's *BRANCH*). Matt 2:23's settling in Natsareth (Nazareth — *Branch-town*) is the geographic fulfillment of the Branch-tradition the Hebrew library walks across both canon and extras. The extras-tier link surfaces the witness the Reformation's canon-truncation cut.

title: The heavens opened at the priestly investiture
summary_md: The heavens-opening at Matt 3:16 — *the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Ruach (Spirit) of Elohim (God) descending like a dove* — sits inside a Hebrew-library tradition of heavens-opening at the moment a covenant-bearing figure is invested for service. Testament of Levi 2:6 (TestXII ch 12:6 in the Charles concatenation) — *behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter* — names the heavens-opening at Levi's priestly investiture. 1 Enoch 14:15 names the Throne-room the open heaven gives access to. 1 Enoch 71:1 names Enoch's ascent into that same Throne-room and the revelation of the Son of Adam. The cosmological room into which Matt 3:16's opened heaven gives access is the same room the Hebrew library had been mapping.

title: The Spirit of Wisdom on the Elect One
summary_md: The Ruach (Spirit) descending dove-form at Matt 3:16 is the same Ruach the Hebrew library had been characterizing for centuries. Wisdom of Solomon 7:22-27 names the Spirit's twenty-one attributes — *holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled* — and frames her as *the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty* (v.25). The dove-form is the visible manifestation of the breath proceeding from the Father. 1 Enoch 49:3 names the Spirit-pattern resting on the Elect One: *in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might* — the same architecture Isaiah 11:2 names of the Messianic-Branch. The Hebrew library's framework — the Ruach as Yahuah's own breath, not as a third co-equal person of a later Trinitarian grid — is the framework the gospel inherits at the immersion.

title: The Father-voice naming the Son of Adam at the investiture
summary_md: Matt 3:17's *voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased* enacts a Father-voice naming the Hebrew library had been carrying. 1 Enoch 39:5 names *the voice of the Holy One ... in the heaven, and the voice of the Elect One ... from the throne of glory* in one breath. 1 Enoch 62:7 is the Hebrew library's direct Father-voice naming the Son of Adam: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not* — the same construction Matt 3:17 enacts at the Yarden (Jordan). Ascension of Isaiah 9:12 frames the descent of the Beloved in human form; Ascension 11:32 frames the ascent and seating at the right hand of the Great Glory. The Hebrew library's framework holds the whole descent-public-naming-ascent arc.

title: The Watcher rebellion as the source of the vipers
summary_md: Yochanan's (John's) *generation of vipers* — Greek *gennēmata echidnōn,* offspring of vipers — at Matt 3:7 names the Pharisaic-Sadducean leadership in the seed-war register the Hebrew library opens at 1 Enoch 6-16 and Jubilees 5 / 10. 1 Enoch 6:1-2 narrates the fallen-Watchers' descent and their breeding of the Nephilim — the tares woven in by the fallen Watchers (Matt 13:24-30, 36-43). 1 Enoch 10:9 names the judgment against *the children of the Watchers* explicitly. Jubilees 5:1 carries the same narrative; Jubilees 10:1 narrates the persistence of the Watcher-spirits as unclean demons after the Flood. The seed-war pattern Yochanan (John) names at Matt 3:7 — and Yahusha (Jesus) re-names at Matt 23:33 and John 8:44 — has this 1 Enoch 6 / Jubilees 5 origin in the Hebrew library's witness. The system is the contemporary face of the persistent seed-war; the people inside are victims of the deception their inherited tradition handed them.

title: Azazel bound in the wilderness as the temptation-ground
summary_md: Matt 4:1 — *Then was Yahusha (Jesus) led up of the Ruach (Spirit) into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil* — reads against 1 Enoch's wilderness-binding architecture. 1 Enoch 8:1 names Azazel's teaching of forbidden arts as the leading edge of the Watcher-rebellion. 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names Yahuah's (the LORD's) binding-judgment on Azazel: *Bind Azazel hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dudael, and cast him therein... place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness... cover his face that he may not see light.* The Watcher-chief is bound in the wilderness. 1 Enoch 10:8 names the Yom Kippur scapegoat-for-Azazel architecture that Leviticus 16:10 carries in shorthand — sin borne away to the wilderness-figure who is its source. Matt 4:1 places Yahusha (Jesus) on the very ground where the bound Watcher is held; the wilderness-temptation is the public confrontation between the Son-of-Adam-in-flesh and the bound Watcher-chief, walked on the Watcher's own territory and passed.

title: The Animal Apocalypse gathering of the dispersed sheep
summary_md: Matt 4:19's *fishers of men* commission and Matt 4:25's early-ministry geographic-scope summary read against the Animal Apocalypse of 1 Enoch 85-90. 1 Enoch 89:74 names the scattering-of-the-sheep — the white-sheep blinded and devoured by the failed shepherds in the apostasy. 1 Enoch 90:6 names the late-age awakening of the lambs — *behold lambs were borne by those white sheep, and they began to open their eyes and to see.* 1 Enoch 90:33 names the great-gathering-into-the-house at the close of the age — *all that had been destroyed and dispersed... assembled in that house.* The disciples are commissioned at Matt 4:19 as the agents of the gathering the Animal Apocalypse names; Matt 4:25's geographic-scope summary is the early-ministry beginning of the consummation the Hebrew library names. The lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) open their eyes when the Shepherd's voice reaches them.

title: The Beatitudes as righteous-elect blessing-register
summary_md: Matt 5:3-12's Beatitudes inherit the Hebrew library's righteous-elect blessing-register — pronounced over the gathered, not enumerated as entry-conditions. 1 Enoch 5:7 names the peace-and-compassion-on-the-elect register the *blessed are the poor in spirit* Beatitude carries forward. 1 Enoch 1:8 names the comfort-and-light promise on the elect that Matt 5:4's *they shall be comforted* walks. 1 Enoch 58:2 carries the direct *blessed-are-the-righteous-and-elect* form behind Matt 5:10's *blessed are they which are persecuted.* Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 names the souls-of-the-righteous-in-the-hand-of-Elohim register the persecution-Beatitudes inherit; Wisdom 3:9 names the *grace and mercy is to his saints, and he has care for his elect* register Matt 5:12's *great is your reward in heaven* walks. The Hebrew library makes plain what the Beatitudes carry forward: the blessing is pronounced on the elect because they are the elect; the Beatitudes describe the citizens already drawn, not the credentials by which the credentialed enter.

title: The light of the elect and the throne of glory
summary_md: Matt 5:14-16's salt-and-light naming — *ye are the light of the world ... a city that is set on an hill cannot be hid ... let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* — reads against 1 Enoch's Parables section. 1 Enoch 58:3 names the architecture directly: *the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life.* The Greek *este* at Matt 5:14 is indicative not imperative — the disciples ARE the light because they ARE the elect. 1 Enoch 38:4 names the throne-of-glory appearing at which the strong of the earth lose their exaltation and the holy stand revealed — the present-age visibility of the gathered foreshadows the consummation-city set on the height of the mountains. 1 Enoch 38:2 names the *righteous-shall-be-victorious-in-the-name* architecture; Matt 5:16's *that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven* walks the same name-glorifying pattern at the present-age level.

title: Woe against those who alter the words and teach men so
summary_md: Matt 5:19 — *whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven* — reads against the Hebrew library's woe-pattern against the alter-and-teach-men-so diagnostic. 1 Enoch 99:2 names the woe directly: *Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law.* 1 Enoch 82:13 carries the exact two-clause architecture the gospel diagnostic walks: *woe to those who alter these things, And lead the sons of men astray, And cause them to transgress the commandments of Yahuah (God) of Spirits* — alter + lead astray + cause to transgress. The Hebrew library's dual-clause woe is the direct architectural parallel to the gospel's dual-clause diagnostic (*break* + *teach men so*). 1 Enoch 95:2 carries the alter-the-words-of-uprightness woe in its sharpest form: *they write their own judgment.* The institutional pulpit that voids the commandments and teaches the congregation to do the same is named by both registers — the Hebrew library's woe and the gospel's kingdom-status diagnostic.

title: Thy name and thy throne in the Enochic prayers
summary_md: Matt 6:9-10's opening of the Lord's Prayer — *Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven* — walks the holy-and-eternal-name + throne-of-glory + kingdom-and-power architecture the Hebrew library's Enochic prayers already carry. 1 Enoch 9:4 names the architecture in the angelic prayer-form: *Yahuah (Lord) of lords, Elohim (God) of elohiym, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory standeth unto all the generations of the world, and Thy Name is holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages.* 1 Enoch 84:2 carries Enoch's own prayer at the same architecture: *Blessed be Thou, O Yahuah (God), King ... And Thy throne is for ever and ever, And Thy name is holy and great for ever and ever.* 1 Enoch 84:3 names the kingdom-and-power register: *Thou hast made all things, And Thou hast power over all things: And all things are naked and open in Thy sight.* The Hebrew library's prayer-architecture is the architecture the Lord's Prayer walks — the same holy Name, the same eternal throne of glory, the same King of kings whose kingdom the citizens pray come and whose will they pray see done in earth. The Ezekiel 36 gathering-prayer (canon) and the Daniel 7 kingdom-transfer to the Son of Adam (canon) hold the gospel-architecture's scriptural anchors; the Enochic prayers carry the same architecture in the wisdom of Enoch the righteous, prayed before the patriarchs in the early chapters of the world.

title: The Two Ways of Enoch and the narrow gate
summary_md: Matt 7:13-14's narrow-gate / wide-gate teaching reads against the Hebrew library's Two-Ways architecture the Tanakh had been carrying from Mosheh (Moses) at Sinai (Deut 30:15-19) through the Psalter (Psalm 1) and the prophets (Jeremiah 21:8) and into the apocalyptic-stream. 1 Enoch 94:1 names the architecture explicitly in the patriarch Enoch's wisdom-testimony: *love righteousness and walk therein; for the paths of righteousness are worthy of acceptance, but the paths of unrighteousness shall suddenly be destroyed and vanish.* 1 Enoch 94:2 carries the asymmetric outcome: *to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and death be revealed, and they shall hold themselves aloof from the paths of righteousness, and they shall not find mercy.* The wisdom-stream had been naming the asymmetric Two-Ways outcome for centuries before the Sermon. Matt 7:13-14 walks the same architecture at the kingdom-citizens level — wide gate to destruction with many entering, narrow gate to life with few finding — and binds it to the King's naming of the kingdom-entry-criterion at vv.21-23 and the two-builders' summary at vv.24-27. The teaching was already in the library; the King restores it.

title: Gather all the tribes of Jacob — Sirach 36 and 1 Enoch 90 and the east-and-west gathering
summary_md: Matt 8:11's *many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Avraham (Abraham), and Yitschaq (Isaac), and Ya'aqov (Jacob), in the kingdom of heaven* walks the Tanakh-prophetic-gathering of the scattered seed coming home — anchored canonically at Isaiah 43:5-6, Isaiah 49:12, Psalm 107:2-3, Zechariah 8:7-8 (carried in the long-form). The Hebrew library's extras-tier witness carries the same architecture in the wisdom-stream and the apocalyptic-stream. Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:11 names the prayer directly: *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* Sirach 36:12 names the firstborn-people standing on which the gathering rests: *Yahuah (God), have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn.* 1 Enoch 90:18 (Animal Apocalypse) names the gathering-at-the-end: *all the beasts and the birds and the wild animals were gathered, and they all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to praise Him.* The vision Enoch saw is what the King is inaugurating at Matt 8:11. The *many from east and west* are the scattered seed coming home — NOT the Christian-replacement-of-the-Jews construct. The framework's posture toward Yahudah (Judah) is unwavering; the *children of the kingdom cast out into outer darkness* at v.12 is the post-harvest sifting of the covenant-claimants-by-lineage-alone, per Ezekiel 20:34-38.

title: The named Son of Adam — 1 Enoch 46 and Matthew 8:20
summary_md: Matt 8:20's *the Son of Adam hath not where to lay his head* is named-title Messianic usage — Yahusha (Jesus) names himself as THE seed-of-Adam-line-of-promise. Red Line #12 governs: the title is capitalized (*Son of Adam*); the kaph-comparative is NOT present at v.20 (distinct from Daniel 7:13 / Revelation 1:13 / Revelation 14:14 where the canon preserves the *like the Son of Adam* construction). 1 Enoch 46:1-3 is the load-bearing Hebrew-library named-title parallel. The Enochic throne-room vision names the figure twice: *that Son of Adam* (v.2) and *the Son of Adam who hath righteousness* (v.3). The figure is identified by role — chosen by Yahuah (God) of Spirits, given the pre-eminence in uprightness for ever, the revealer of all hidden treasures, located beside the Head of Days. This is the Christ in heavenly vision before the incarnation. The figure named at 1 Enoch 46 is the figure named at Matt 8:20. The Hebrew library carries the named-title; the gospel restores it in the King's own self-naming. The Christian commentary that flattens *son of man* to a generic *mortal human* title and then lets it carry weight only by Daniel 7:13's apparent transcendence-language loses both the lineage-weight that *son of Adam* carries and the named-title parallel that 1 Enoch 46 secures.

title: Spirits from the giants and the demons partially restrained — 1 Enoch 15-16 and Jubilees 10
summary_md: Matt 8:28-29's Gergesene/Gadarene exorcism — *what have we to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God)? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?* — walks the Hebrew library's demon-origin and partial-restraint architecture. 1 Enoch 15:9 names the spirits-from-the-giants demon-origin: *the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble.* 1 Enoch 16:1 (with the wider 15-16 architecture) names the appointed-judgment-time the demons themselves know. Jubilees 10:1 names the post-flood demon-administration: *the unclean demons began to lead astray the children of the sons of Noah; and to make to err and destroy them.* Jubilees 10:8 names the Mastema-partial-restraint architecture: *the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me ... for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men.* A tenth part of the demons is left subject before Satan on the earth until the appointed time (Jubilees 10:11). The Hebrew library had named the demon-origin and the partial-restraint and the appointed eschatological-judgment for the rebellious-spirit-beings; the Matt 8:28-29 demoniacs recognize the King precisely because they know the architecture the Hebrew library had named. The *before the time* fear at v.29 is the demons' acknowledgment of the appointed-judgment-timeline Jubilees 10 and 1 Enoch 15-16 had named.

title: The named Son of Adam in the Similitudes of Enoch — pre-existence, naming, and enthronement at Matt 9:6
summary_md: Matt 9:6's *the Son of Adam hath power on earth to forgive sins* — read against the Similitudes of Enoch's named-Son-of-Adam architecture. 1 Enoch 48:2-3 names the Son of Adam's pre-existence-and-naming-before-the-Head-of-Days — the name was named before the sun and the signs were created. 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son of Adam as the one over whom righteousness abides eternally. Matt 9:6 is the in-flesh exercise of the authority 1 Enoch had named as eternally-pre-existent. The figure who has the Father's-forgiveness-prerogative in flesh is the figure 1 Enoch had named as pre-existent; the righteousness that abides over him is the architecture of the forgiveness-flow he exercises in flesh. Red Line #12 governs the named-title rendering — this is the title-naming case (not the kaph-comparative case of Daniel 7:13 / Rev 1:13 / Rev 14:14 where the comparative is preserved). S137 Thread 10 anchored the named-title parallel at Matt 8:20 with 1 Enoch 46:1-3; this thread extends the architecture into the forgiveness-prerogative-exercise register at Matt 9:6 with 1 Enoch 48 and 62.

title: The Animal Apocalypse — shepherds judged, new house built, sheep gathered (1 Enoch 90)
summary_md: Matt 9:36's *fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd* — read against the Animal Apocalypse's diagnosis-judgment-restoration arc in 1 Enoch 90. The Tanakh-anchors of the *sheep having no shepherd* language (Numbers 27:17, 1 Kings 22:17, Jeremiah 50:6, Ezekiel 34 full, Zechariah 10:2 / 13:7) are canon-anchored and walked in matthew-9.md §7; this thread surfaces the Animal Apocalypse's direct architecture. 1 Enoch 90:16 names the shepherds-who-had-not-fed-the-sheep judgment explicitly — the false-shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) cast into the fiery abyss for failing the flock. 1 Enoch 90:17 names the restoration architecture — the Lord of the sheep builds a new house greater than the first and brings all the sheep into it. 1 Enoch 90:18 names the gathering-and-fear-of-the-Lord-of-the-sheep architecture at the end of the arc. Matt 9:36's present-tense seeing of the scattered multitudes is the Shepherd's arrival at the moment the gathering 1 Enoch 90 had named begins to be enacted in flesh — the King is the Yechezk'el-34 shepherd AND the Lord of the sheep the Animal Apocalypse had named.

title: Names in the books of life not blotted out — 1 Enoch 103 and the confess-or-deny architecture
summary_md: Matt 10:32-33's confession-and-denial-mirror-pattern — read against 1 Enoch 103's wisdom-stream articulation of the books-of-life-and-the-name-not-blotted-out architecture. 1 Enoch 103:3 names the operative-fact: *your spirits have been found worthy of the lot of the righteous, And your names are written in the books of life before the Most High.* 1 Enoch 103:8 names the preservation: *their memorial shall be before the Most High, And their name shall not be blotted out.* The framework's Red Line #11 reading of the names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world / names-can-only-be-blotted-out (Exodus 32:33; Psalm 69:28; Revelation 3:5) — names are not added after the foundation but are written before and can be blotted out for unfaithfulness — is anchored at this wisdom-stream witness. Matt 10:32-33's confess-or-deny walks the same architecture: the lived-confessor is recognized by the King because the name is preserved; the denier under pressure risks the blotting-out the King has named at Matthew 7:23's *depart from me, ye that work iniquity* dismissal-pattern.

title: Family-division in the day of destruction — 1 Enoch 99-100 and the seed-war at family-level
summary_md: Matt 10:34-36's sword-not-peace household-division saying (citing Micah 7:6) — read against 1 Enoch 99-100's wisdom-stream apocalyptic-register naming of the household-disintegration in the day of destruction. 1 Enoch 99:5 names parents-abandoning-children-perishing-through-them. 1 Enoch 100:1-2 names fathers-and-sons-smitten-together and brothers-falling-on-brothers-in-death. The framework reads the seed-war (Genesis 3:15) as operative at the household-level — the kingdom-citizens' hearing of the Shepherd's voice creates a division-line the family-relationship cannot insulate from. The wisdom-stream had named the household-disintegration as the apocalyptic-day-of-destruction signature; the King at Matt 10:34-36 names the kingdom-hearing-of-his-voice as producing the division-line that runs through the household in the present age. Both witnesses name one diagnostic at the household-level from two angles: the apocalyptic-final-disintegration and the present-age-hearing-of-the-Shepherd that prefigures it.

title: The Messianic-age-restoration substance — 1 Enoch 5 and 10, Jubilees 23
summary_md: Matt 11:5's Messianic-credential answer *the blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, and the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them* (citing Isaiah 35:5-6, 29:18-19, 26:19, 61:1) — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the Messianic-age-restoration architecture. 1 Enoch 5:7-9 names the elect-blessing-substance: peace to the righteous, protection of the elect, compassion, prosperity, blessing, the light shining. 1 Enoch 10:17-22 names the latter-day-restoration: the righteous escape, beget thousands, complete their days in peace; the earth tilled in righteousness, planted with vines, cleansed from oppression and unrighteousness; all the children of men become righteous. Jubilees 23:27-29 names the long-days, the peace-and-joy, the no-Satan-no-evil-destroyer days of blessing-and-healing. The framework reads Matt 11:5's credentialing-signs as the inaugurated-foretaste of the full Messianic-age-restoration substance the wisdom-stream had named — the first-coming substance is now-operative; the day-of-vengeance of Isaiah 61:2 is reserved for the second-coming per the deliberate-omission.

title: The Son of Adam named before the Head of Days, revealing the treasures of that which is hidden — 1 Enoch 46-51
summary_md: Matt 11:25-27's Father-Son revelation-economy prayer — *I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes ... no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him* — read against 1 Enoch 46-51's wisdom-stream architecture of the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-Head-of-Days-revealing-mysteries. Four moves: 1 Enoch 46:1 names the Father-Son architecture at the apocalyptic-register — the Head-of-Days (the Father) and the Son-of-Adam-whose-countenance-had-the-appearance-of-a-man-and-whose-face-was-full-of-graciousness (the Son, Red Line #12 title-naming case where the kaph-comparative is NOT operative); 1 Enoch 46:3 names the *Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* (direct revelation-economy substance); 1 Enoch 48:6 names the Son *chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore* (Red Line #11's names-written-before-the-foundation-of-the-world architecture extended to the Son himself); 1 Enoch 48:7 names the revelation-economy *the wisdom of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous.* The wisdom-stream had named the architecture; the King at Matt 11:25-27 names it operative in his own voice as the Word-made-flesh.

title: The eschatological reversal — the righteous stands in great boldness before those who condemned him — Wisdom of Solomon 5 and 1 Enoch 95
summary_md: Matt 12:14's Pharisaic-council-to-destroy — *then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him* — read against the wisdom-stream's eschatological-reversal-of-the-righteous-condemned architecture. Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 5:1 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation — *then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him* — the eschatological-reversal at the day-of-judgment; Wisdom 5:4-5 names the system's-belated-recognition — *we fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour: How is he numbered among the children of Elohim (God)*; 1 Enoch 95:7 names the woe-against-the-persecutors-of-the-righteous architecture — *woe to you, sinners, who persecute the righteous.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:14's trajectory-from-challenging-the-disciples (Matt 9:11) to slandering-the-King (Matt 11:18-19) to plotting-destruction (Matt 12:14): the same trajectory the wisdom-stream had named at its eschatological-end-point. The day-of-judgment reverses the verdict the system rendered in the present age; the King at Matt 12:14 walks toward the cross under the same architecture; the resurrection is the operative-vindication; and the same architecture operates today against the heart-Torah-walking kingdom-citizens with the same eschatological-reversal awaiting.

title: The Spirit-anointed Elect-One — the spirit of wisdom and the spirit of righteousness poured out on the Son — 1 Enoch 49 and 62
summary_md: Matt 12:18-21's citation of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 42:1-4 — *behold my servant, whom I have chosen ... I will put my spirit upon him* — read against 1 Enoch's wisdom-stream articulation of the Spirit-anointing on the Elect-One. Three moves: 1 Enoch 49:1 names the wisdom-poured-out-on-the-Elect-One architecture; 1 Enoch 49:3 names the four-spirits-on-the-Elect-One — the same Isaiah 11:2 four-spirits-cluster (the spirit of wisdom and understanding, of counsel and might, of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (the LORD)) applied directly to the Elect-One; 1 Enoch 62:2 names the Elect-One enthroned with the spirit-of-righteousness poured out upon him and the word-of-his-mouth as the operative-instrument at the day-of-judgment. The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:18-21: the Tanakh-anchor (Isaiah 42:1-4 / 11:2), the wisdom-stream restatement (1 Enoch 49 / 62), and the gospel-fulfillment (Matt 12:18-21 / 3:16-17 / 17:5) name one Spirit-anointing-architecture across three registers. The present-age ministry stages the credentialing-in-mercy-substance (Matt 12:19-20's meek-King-disposition and bruised-reed-mercy); the eschatological-consummation lands the judgment-unto-victory (Matt 12:20c) at the second-coming the wisdom-stream had named at the throne-of-glory register.

title: The binding of the Watchers — Azazel hand-and-foot, the chains prepared for the hosts, nine-tenths bound — as typological-anchor for binding the strong-man — 1 Enoch 10, 1 Enoch 54, Jubilees 10
summary_md: Matt 12:28-29's *if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you. Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house* — read against the wisdom-stream's binding-of-the-watchers architecture. Three moves: 1 Enoch 10:4-5 names the binding-of-Azazel — hand-and-foot, cast-into-the-darkness, sealed-with-rocks, covered-with-darkness for the appointed-time; 1 Enoch 54:5 names the chains-prepared-for-Azazel-and-his-hosts and the casting-into-the-abyss-of-complete-condemnation; Jubilees 10:9-11 names the watchers-bound-with-a-tenth-permitted architecture — nine-tenths bound in the place-of-condemnation, one-tenth permitted before Satan on the earth. The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:29: the King's exorcisms-and-spoiling are the inaugurated-form of the binding-architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the watcher-leader register; the full-binding-of-Satan at Revelation 20:1-3 lands the architecture at the millennial-consummation; the brief-final-loosing at Rev 20:7-10 lands the architecture's terminus. The kingdom-citizens operate in the inaugurated-binding-substance now; the full-binding lands at the consummation; and the King's exorcisms-as-spoiling at Matt 12:28-29 are the visible-evidence of the kingdom-arrival the wisdom-stream had named.

title: No forgiveness for the hardened disposition — the deliberate covenant-rejection, the no-place-of-repentance, the cogitation that would never be changed — Jubilees 15, 1 Enoch 65, Wisdom of Solomon 12
summary_md: Matt 12:31-32's framework-major blasphemy-against-the-Ruach warning — *the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men ... neither in this world, neither in the world to come* — read against the wisdom-stream's no-forgiveness-for-the-hardened-disposition architecture. Three moves: Jubilees 15:33-34 names the great-wrath-no-forgiveness for the deliberate-covenant-rejection — *there will be great wrath from Yahuah (the Lord) ... because they have forsaken His covenant and have turned aside from His word*; 1 Enoch 65:11 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the no-place-of-repentance architecture — those who have witnessed-the-sin and rejected-the-sentence have *no place of repentance for them*; Wisdom of Solomon 12:10 names the cogitation-that-would-never-be-changed architecture — Yahuah (God) gives place-of-repentance not being-ignorant of the bred-in malice and the cogitation that will-never-be-changed. The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:31-32's warning: the wisdom-stream knew the hardened-disposition-against-correction as a possibility-of-the-heart; the deliberate-attribution of the Ruach's-credentialing-work to demonic-agency by those who have seen the credentialing-clearly IS that hardened-disposition. The framework's pastoral-reading holds: those who FEAR they have committed it almost certainly have not — the fear is itself evidence of conscience-still-functioning; the hardening-into-the-disposition has not taken hold. The same diagnostic operates against the institutional-religious-system's historical pattern of rebranding the Ruach's-work as something else — Pharisees, Galatian agitators, institutional Christianity, modern Hebrew Roots' false-inclusion gospel, Islam — four costumes on one architecture; the contrary-to-Torah test of 1 John 2:3-4 identifies the lie in any of them.

title: Resurrection from Sheol — the gates of the dead give back what they have received — the sign-of-Yonah three-days-three-nights architecture — Wisdom of Solomon 16, 1 Enoch 51, Jubilees 23
summary_md: Matt 12:38-42's sign-of-Yonah refusal-and-promise — *as Yonah (Jonah) was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth* — read against the wisdom-stream's resurrection-from-Sheol architecture. Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 names the direct gates-of-Sheol-and-bring-up-again architecture — *thou hast power of life and death: thou leadest to the gates of Sheol, and bringest up again*; 1 Enoch 51:1 names the earth-and-Sheol-and-hell-giving-back architecture — *the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received*; Jubilees 23:30 names the rise-up-and-see-great-peace architecture — *the Lord will heal His servants, And they shall rise up and see great peace.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:40: the sign-of-Yonah is the resurrection-credential pre-announcement — three-days-and-three-nights of the King's-future death-and-burial-and-resurrection. The wisdom-stream knew the descent-to-Sheol-and-bring-up-again architecture; the King at Matt 12:40 names the inaugurated-form in his own future-resurrection. The framework holds the literal three-days-and-three-nights count; the Friday-evening-to-Sunday-morning traditional Christian reading does not preserve the literal substance.

title: Wisdom hidden from the wicked and revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 48, 2 Esdras 5, Wisdom of Solomon 1, and Sirach 39
summary_md: Matt 13:10-17's parables-method and the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 6:9-10 hardening-citation — *because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given ... they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand* — read against the wisdom-stream's wisdom-hidden-from-the-wicked-revealed-to-the-elect architecture. Four moves: 1 Enoch 48:7 names the wisdom-of-the-Lord-of-Spirits revealed-to-the-holy-and-righteous; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 5:9-10 names the wisdom-and-understanding-withdrawing-into-the-secret-chamber and sought-of-many-and-not-found in the latter-days; Wisdom of Solomon 1:4 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin*; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 39:6 names the spirit-of-understanding poured-out-on-the-elect-scribe when-the-great-Yahuah-wills. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11: the giving precedes the hearing (the Greek *dedotai* at v.11 — passive perfect, *it has been given*); the disciples receive the mysteries because the disposition-to-receive has-been-given; the multitudes do-not-receive because the disposition-to-reject has-closed-the-soul. The wisdom-stream had named the architecture explicitly at the soul-disposition register; the King names the operative-form at the parables-method register. The Father does not actively-prevent the hearing; the disposition-closes-itself; the wisdom encounters-the-closure. The cause-and-effect-reversal Red Line #11 establishes — *if you hear, you are sons of Avraham (Abraham); you are sons of Adam* (you did not become these things by hearing; you heard because you are these things) — operates across both the wisdom-stream witnesses and the King's parables-method.

title: The birds-of-the-air snatching the seed as Mastema and the watchers' work — Jubilees 11 and 1 Enoch 19
summary_md: Matt 13:4's *fowls came and devoured them up* with the King's-own-interpretation at Matt 13:19 (*then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart*) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the adversary-sending-birds-to-snatch-the-seed architecture. Two moves: Jubilees 11:11 names THE strongest direct verbal-anchor — *Prince Mastema sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, so as to rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked it from the surface of the ground*; 1 Enoch 19:1 names the spirits-of-the-watchers leading-mankind-astray into sacrificing-to-demons-as-gods as the operative-mechanism. The framework reads the cluster as locking the framework's reading of Matt 13:4-19 against any reading that treats the birds-of-the-air as neutral-wildlife. The fowls of Matt 13:4 are the wicked-one-of-Matt-13:19 in operative-form, the same Mastema-Satan-substance the wisdom-stream had named. The Avraham-driving-away-the-fowls at Bereshit (Genesis) 15:11 + the Jubilees 11:11 Mastema-sending-the-birds + the Matt 13:4-19 King's-naming-the-wicked-one walk one architecture across the canon and the wisdom-stream. The framework reads the architecture in continuity with the mustard-seed parable's birds-of-the-air lodging in the branches at vv.31-32 — the same fowl-substance carries through both parables, naming the corruption-pattern operating within the kingdom's-visible-growth alongside the wheat.

title: The watchers' corruption as tares sown in the wheat — 1 Enoch 6, 10, 15, and Jubilees 5, 7 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 13:25 and 13:38 — *while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares ... the tares are the children of the wicked one; the enemy that sowed them is the devil* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the watchers' incursion and the corrupted-line architecture. Five moves: 1 Enoch 6:1-6 names the watchers' incursion — *the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children*; 1 Enoch 10:9 names the children-of-the-watchers as *the bastards and the reprobates ... children of fornication* — a paternal-source-distinguishable-people; 1 Enoch 15:8-9 names the spirits-of-the-giants as *evil spirits upon the earth* operating-on-the-earth as the operative-instruments of the wicked-one's sowing across the age; Jubilees 5:1-2 corroborates the watchers' incursion at the second-witness register — *the angels of Yahuah saw them and took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare unto them sons and they were giants*; Jubilees 7:21-22 names the multiple-corrupted-lineages (Naphidim, Naphil, Eljo) from the watchers' fornication. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #11 seed-war architecture: the wisdom-stream had named the children-of-the-watchers as a paternal-source-distinguishable-people; the King at Matt 13:25, 38 names the operative-form of the children-of-the-wicked-one as a paternal-source-distinguishable-people-within-the-field-of-the-world. The seed-distinction operates at the paternal-source level; the watchers' incursion at Bereshit (Genesis) 6:1-4 produces a corrupted-line + corrupted-spirits operating-within-the-field-of-the-world as the seed-of-the-wicked-one alongside the seed-of-Adam. Two wisdom-stream witnesses (1 Enoch AND Jubilees) establish the substance the King's parable names; the framework reads the architecture WITHOUT collapsing into the racial-determinism that the Black-Hebrew-Israelite-movement and various-other-systems have produced — the seed-distinction is real BUT operates within every people, not categorically along ethnic-lines; the harvest is the sorting; the present-age cannot finally-determine the sort by visible-criteria.

title: Binding the watchers at the day of judgment with fire — 1 Enoch 10, 54, and 90
summary_md: Matt 13:30, 41-42 — *gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them ... the Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity; And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the eschatological-binding-and-burning-of-the-watchers architecture. Three moves: 1 Enoch 10:13-14 names *they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever*; 1 Enoch 54:6 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *Mikha'el (Michael), and Gavri'el (Gabriel), and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace*; 1 Enoch 90:25 names the seventy-shepherds-judged and *cast into an abyss, full of fire and flaming, and full of pillars of fire* (in the animal-apocalypse register). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the eschatological-judgment-architecture the King's wheat-and-tares-interpretation names. The reapers-are-the-angels of v.39 + the gathering-out-of-his-kingdom-all-things-that-offend of v.41 + the casting-into-the-furnace-of-fire of v.42 all operate in the architecture the wisdom-stream had named with specific-archangelic-naming and specific-abyss-of-fire-language. The framework reads this in continuity with the S142 thread (binding-of-the-watchers-typological-anchor-for-binding-the-strong-man at Matt 12:29) — the inaugurated-binding at the King's present-age-ministry is the same architecture as the eschatological-final-binding-and-burning at the harvest; the present chapter's wheat-and-tares parable names the final-binding-and-burning the inaugurated-binding-of-the-strong-man at Matt 12:29 anticipates.

title: The righteous shall shine as the sun in the kingdom of their Father — 1 Enoch 104, 2 Esdras 7, and Wisdom of Solomon 3 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 13:43's *then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father* read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the righteous-shining-as-the-sun-and-as-the-stars architecture. Four moves: 1 Enoch 104:2 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *now shall ye shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you*; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:97 names *the sixth order, when it is shewed them how their face shall shine as the sun, and how they shall be made like unto the light of the stars, being henceforth incorruptible*; 2 Esdras 7:125 names *the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars*; Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 names *in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the eschatological-vindication architecture of the gathered-and-sifted-wheat: the wisdom-stream had named the architecture-of-the-righteous-shining at the resurrection-orders register, the abstinent-righteous register, AND the visitation-of-the-righteous register; the King at Matt 13:43 names the operative-form at the wheat-and-tares-interpretation register. Three wisdom-stream witnesses + the Tanakh-anchor at Daniel 12:3 (*they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament*) establish the substance the King's parable interpretation names. The framework reads the architecture in continuity with the post-harvest-sifting per Red Line #11: the gathered-wheat that has-borne-fruit and survived the rod-of-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 20:37-38 shines-as-the-sun in the kingdom of the Father; the sparks-among-the-stubble of Wisdom 3:7 carries the harvest-and-burning imagery directly — the same harvest the King's parable names, with the righteous-shining-as-sparks-among-the-burning-tares at the day of separation.

title: Mysteries hidden from the foundation of the world revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 46, 1 Enoch 48, Wisdom of Solomon 6, and 2 Esdras 6
summary_md: Matt 13:34-35's *all these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables ... That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world* (citing Psalm 78:2) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the mysteries-hidden-from-the-foundation revealed-to-the-elect architecture. Four moves: 1 Enoch 48:6 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Elect-One *hidden before him, before the creation of the world and for evermore* and revealed at the appointed-time; 1 Enoch 46:3 names the Son-of-Adam as the One-who-reveals-the-treasures-of-that-which-is-hidden — *this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness, and who reveals all the treasures of that which is hidden*; Wisdom of Solomon 6:22 names *as for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you*; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 6:26-28 names the latter-days when *the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the mysteries-secret-from-the-foundation-revealed-by-the-Son-of-Adam architecture: the wisdom-stream had named the architecture explicitly at the Elect-One register AND at the wisdom-teacher register; the King at Matt 13:34-35 names the operative-form of the architecture in his own parables-method. The Sower-of-the-good-seed of v.37 IS the Son-of-Adam the wisdom-stream had named as the Revealer-of-the-hidden-treasures; the parables-method is the operative-form of the office; the disciples-receive-the-revealing because they have-been-given-to-receive (per the cause-and-effect of Red Line #11 the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 6:9-10 citation at vv.13-15 has just established).

title: Wheat from chaff and righteous from wicked at the day of separation — 2 Esdras 7, 2 Esdras 8, 1 Enoch 100, and Wisdom of Solomon 3
summary_md: Matt 13:47-50's dragnet-parable — *the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away. So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the wheat-from-chaff-and-righteous-from-wicked-at-the-day-of-separation architecture. Four moves: 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 7:33-35 names *the most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end: But judgment only shall remain*; 2 Esdras 8:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *many be created, but few shall be saved*; 1 Enoch 100:5 names *over all the righteous and holy he will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels to guard them as the apple of an eye, until he makes an end of all wickedness and all sin*; Wisdom of Solomon 3:8 names *they shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream restatement of the eschatological-separation the dragnet-parable recapitulates. The wheat-and-tares-interpretation at vv.36-43 named the architecture; the dragnet-parable at vv.47-50 recapitulates it from the sea-and-net angle; the wisdom-stream had named the architecture at multiple registers (the most-High-on-the-seat-of-judgment AND the few-saved-architecture AND the angelic-guardians AND the righteous-judge-the-nations). The framework reads this in continuity with the kingdom-of-priests destination-of-the-gathered-remnant per Red Line #7: the righteous-judge-and-rule the nations-left-after-the-judgment at the millennial-reign; the wisdom-stream and the gospel walk one architecture from the day-of-separation through the millennial-reign of the gathered-remnant ministering as priests to the nations.

title: The seed-war from Genesis 3 forward with the devil as source of death — Wisdom of Solomon 2:24, 1 Enoch 22, and Jubilees 4 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 13:38-39's *the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one; The enemy that sowed them is the devil* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the seed-war-from-Bereshit (Genesis)-3-forward-with-the-devil-as-source-of-death architecture. Three moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it* (the devil-as-source-of-death entering-the-world; they-that-hold-of-his-side find-death — the architecture the children-of-the-wicked-one operate within); 1 Enoch 22:5-7 names the spirits-of-the-dead separated-into-four-divisions with the spirit-of-Hevel (Abel) crying-out-against-Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-victim-crying-for-vindication; Jubilees 4:2 names the wisdom-stream restatement of the Bereshit (Genesis) 4 architecture — *Qayin (Cain) slew Hevel (Abel) because (God) accepted the sacrifice of Hevel (Abel), and did not accept the offering of Qayin (Cain) ... and his blood cried from the ground to heaven.* The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the Red Line #11 seed-war architecture: the wisdom-stream identifies the devil as the source-of-death-and-corruption from the beginning (the serpent of Bereshit 3 + the envy that brings death into the world); the wisdom-stream identifies Qayin (Cain) as the seed-war's first-fruit of the children-of-the-wicked-one (corroborated by 1 Yochanan (John) 3:12's *not as Qayin (Cain), who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother*); the wisdom-stream identifies Hevel (Abel) as the first-victim of the architecture. The King at Matt 13:38-39 names the operative-form of the architecture the wisdom-stream had named at the foundational register. The architecture operates from Bereshit (Genesis) 3 forward through the field-of-the-world to the harvest; the devil's envy at Bereshit 3 + the devil's seduction at the watchers (1 Enoch 6-11) + the devil's sowing-of-tares at Matt 13:39 = one architecture of the source-of-death-and-corruption across the canon and the wisdom-stream.

title: The Son of the living Elohim named before the foundation — 1 Enoch 46 and 48, and Wisdom of Solomon 2 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 16:13-17's Caesarea-Philippi-confession sequence — the King's-credentialing-question *whom do men say that I the Son of Adam am?* (v.13), Kefa's (Peter's) *thou art the Messiah, the Son of the living Elohim (God)* (v.16), and the King's-blessing *flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven* (v.17) — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam / Son-of-the-living-Elohim named-before-the-foundation substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:2 names the wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the Son-of-Adam title the King uses of himself (*concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, and why he went with the Head of Days*); 1 Enoch 46:3 names the depth of the Son-of-Adam's identity (*this is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, with whom dwelleth righteousness*); 1 Enoch 48:2 names the heavenly-naming-of-the-Christ at the throne (*that Son of Adam was named in the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, and his name before the Head of Days*); 1 Enoch 48:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the before-the-foundation-of-the-world naming (*before the sun and the signs were created, before the stars of the heaven were made, his name was named before Yahuah (God) of Spirits*); Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 names the just-man-as-the-son-of-Yahuah substance in the prefiguring-passage (*if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him*). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operating at the Caesarea-Philippi-confession. Kefa's (Peter's)-confession articulates at the earthly-gospel-pivot what the Parables-of-Enoch and the Wisdom-of-Solomon-prefiguring-passage had named at the heavenly-throne and wisdom-stream-prefiguring registers centuries before. The Father's-revelation to Kefa (Peter) reveals what was always true — the Son-of-Adam's name was named before the foundation of the world; the cause-and-effect-of-hearing operates at the Father's revealing the same substance the wisdom-stream had carried.

title: The Elect One on the throne and the Davidic stewardship keys — 1 Enoch 49, 51, 62, and 69 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 16:19's *I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Elect-One on the throne and the sum-of-judgment-committed-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance. Four moves: 1 Enoch 49:2 names the Elect-One-as-the-Standing-One-before-Yahuah-of-Spirits to whom the secrets-of-righteousness are committed (*he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness ... because the Elect One stands before Yahuah (the Lord) of Spirits*); 1 Enoch 51:3 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Elect-One-on-the-throne substance (*the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, and his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel*); 1 Enoch 62:7 names the Son-of-Adam revealed-to-the-holy-and-elect substance (*the righteousness of the Elect One of Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and elect*); 1 Enoch 69:27 names the sum-of-judgment-given-unto-the-Son-of-Adam substance (*he sat on the throne of his glory, and the sum of judgment was given unto the Son of Adam*). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the apostolic-stewardship's derivation from the King's-own-throne-position. The short.md walks the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 22:15-25 Shevna-and-Elyakim succession as the Tanakh-architecture for the demotion-of-the-self-credentialing-Shevna-class (the contemporary Pharisaic-and-Sadducean second-Temple-aristocracy) and the elevation-of-the-Elyakim-class-of-apostolic-stewardship the King establishes at Kefa's confession; the 1 Enoch Parables-cluster carries the upstream-architecture for the King's-own-throne-position from which the keys are delegated. The King-as-the-Elect-One holds-the-throne and the sum-of-judgment; the King delegates the keys-of-the-kingdom-of-heaven to the apostolic-stewardship from that throne-position; the binding-and-loosing-substance the apostolic-stewardship exercises operates downstream-of-and-in-accountability-to the Son-of-Adam's-own-sum-of-judgment. The inherited-Roman-Catholic-magisterial-authority-to-define-doctrine-against-scripture reading is ruled out — the apostolic-keys administer what-the-Master-of-the-House-has-given, not what-the-stewards-define-against-the-Master.

title: The gates of Sheol and the resurrection substance — Wisdom of Solomon 1 and 16, 1 Enoch 51, and 2 Esdras 4
summary_md: Matt 16:18's *the gates of hell shall not prevail against it* — the King's-promise to the assembly-built-on-the-Rock that the gates-of-Sheol/Hades will not have-final-authority — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gates-of-Sheol and the resurrection-substance. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 1:13 names the death-is-not-from-Yahuah substance (*Yahuah (God) made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living*); Wisdom of Solomon 16:13 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the gates-of-hell-and-the-bringing-up-again substance (*you have power of life and death: you leadest to the gates of hell, and bringest up again*); 1 Enoch 51:1 names the Sheol-giving-back-the-dead substance (*Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, and hell shall give back that which it owes*); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 4:35 names the souls-of-the-righteous-in-their-chambers substance (*did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion?*). The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the gates-of-Sheol/Hades-substance the King's-promise enacts. The gates-of-Sheol carry the power-of-death-and-the-grave that entered through the curse-of-Bereshit (Genesis)-3 (Wisdom of Solomon 1:13's articulation that the Father is-not-the-source-of-death); the Father's-power leads-to-the-gates-and-brings-up-again (Wisdom of Solomon 16:13); the eschatological-architecture has Sheol-giving-back-the-dead and the chambers-delivering-the-souls (1 Enoch 51:1 + 2 Esdras 4:35); the King's-resurrection at the sign-of-Yonah is the operative-substance that breaks the gates' hold-against the assembly-built-on-him; the assembly partakes-of-the-resurrection-substance through-the-King at the first-resurrection per Revelation 20:4-6. The framework reads against the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment-hell reading of *gates of hell* — the Tanakh-substance and the wisdom-stream-substance carry the gates as the power-of-death-and-the-grave, not as the door to an eternal-conscious-torment institutional-Christian-doctrine.

title: The Watcher-rebellion as the stumbling-block architecture — 1 Enoch 8-27 read against Matt 18:6-9's millstone-warning + sin-amputation + gehenna (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 18:6-9's millstone-warning against offending the little-ones-who-believe + the sin-amputation against the disciple's-own-stumbling-substance + the gehenna-of-fire-judgment — read against the wisdom-stream's articulation of the original-stumbling-block architecture in 1 Enoch. Five moves: 1 Enoch 8:1 names THE architectural-root of the *skandalon* substance — the watchers' teaching of the corrupting-arts (weapons, antimony-for-the-eyelids, costly stones, colouring-tinctures) the substance-of-which placed-the-stumbling-blocks across the way of the walker; 1 Enoch 10:8 names the whole earth's-corruption-through-the-watcher-taught-substance — the architecture under the King's *it must needs be that offences come* (Matt 18:7); 1 Enoch 19:1 names the lying-spirits-leading-astray in many-forms across the present-age — the architecture under every-system-of-stumbling-block the King's millstone-warning lands-on (the institutional-Christianity's antinomian-doctrine, the Hebrew-Roots false-inclusion gospel, the Pharisaic-traditions-of-the-elders, the Galatian-circumcision-party, the Islamic-transfer — the four-costumes per voice skill framework); 1 Enoch 22:11 names the place-of-the-eternal-judgment for those who-perpetuated-the-substance — the consummation-of-the-judgment the King names as *better* than the millstone-and-the-sea-mercy; 1 Enoch 27:2 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the accursed-valley-of-judgment substance — the Watcher-Book passage describing the valley at the centre of the holy mountain that pre-figures the *gei-Hinnom* (Valley of the sons of Hinnom) on the southern-edge of Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) the King's gehenna names. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR: the wisdom-stream's articulation of the seed-war operating architecturally from the watcher-fall through the present-age is the architecture under the inevitability-of-offences the King names; the woe-to-the-man-by-whom-the-offence-cometh is the same architecture 1 Enoch names the eternal judgment-substance for; the gehenna-substance is the Tanakh-and-wisdom-stream's accursed-valley-of-judgment carried-forward, NOT the inherited-Christian-eternal-conscious-torment doctrine read-back into the substance. The little-ones-led-astray are victims-not-enemies per voice skill's patience-not-condescension posture; the systems-and-the-leadership-who-perpetuate-the-corruption are where the woe lands.

title: The Lord of the sheep and the gathering — 1 Enoch's Animal Apocalypse (ch 89-90) read against Matt 18:10-14's despise-not-the-little-ones + their-angels + the lost-sheep parable (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 18:10-14's pivot — the despise-not-the-little-ones warning + the guardian-messengers-behold-the-face-of-my-Father substance + the Son-of-Adam-is-come-to-save-the-lost mission-statement + the lost-sheep-shepherd parable + the Father's-will-substance — read against the wisdom-stream's most-direct shepherd-substance running-in-parallel with Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's Tanakh-shepherd-substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 40:9 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the four-presences-before-the-Father — Michael the merciful-and-long-suffering, Raphael over sickness-and-wounds, Gabriel over the powers, Phanuel over the repentance-unto-hope — the messengers' direct-throne-access architecture the King names at v.10 (*in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father*); 1 Enoch 89:42 names the Lord-of-the-sheep's-acting-substance against the beasts-and-birds-of-the-heaven who devour the sheep — the wisdom-stream's Animal-Apocalypse carrying-forward of the Tanakh-Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34 shepherd-substance into apocalyptic-vision-form; 1 Enoch 89:54 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the Lord-of-the-sheep-title-substance — the wisdom-stream identifies the Lord-of-the-sheep with Yahuah by name; 1 Enoch 90:6 names the lambs-that-open-their-eyes-substance the post-judgment opening-of-the-eyes-of-the-sheep-who-had-been-blinded; 1 Enoch 90:18 names the consummation-rejoicing the Lord-of-the-sheep walks-toward — *all feared the Lord of the sheep, and they began to fall down upon his face and to worship him* — the wisdom-stream's articulation of the gathering-substance the King's shepherd-parable enacts at the historical-pivot. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #7's reading of the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope: the Matt 18 shepherd-parable lands at two-levels-simultaneously — the assembly's-internal-little-ones AND the canon-wide lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) mission-scope per Matt 10:6 and Matt 15:24. Both levels derive from the same Lord-of-the-sheep architecture 1 Enoch had carried-forward from Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34. The cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11 operates in the architecture of the lambs-who-open-the-eyes being-the-substance who-hear-when-the-Shepherd-calls; the gathering is the Father's-will-substance per v.14, not the universalist-overriding-determinism.

title: Woes on the rich and riches cannot save — 1 Enoch 94-100 on Matt 19:23-26
summary_md: Matt 19:23-26's camel-through-the-eye-of-a-needle hyperbole + the disciples' *who then can be saved?* + the King's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* — the substance the rich-young-ruler at vv.16-22 has-just-illustrated extended to the substance the kingdom-citizens'-substance carries-with-them as-the-substantial-warning — read against the Enochic wisdom-stream's extended-corpus-of-woes-against-trust-in-wealth and the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance. Five moves: 1 Enoch 94:3 names THE direct Enochic verbal-anchor for the woe-against-trust-in-riches substance (*woe to you who are rich! For you have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall you depart, Because you have not remembered Yahuah (God) of Spirits in the days of your riches*) — the same substance the King names at Matt 19:23's *a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven*; 1 Enoch 97:7 names the rich-man's-self-congratulation substance (*we have become rich with riches and have possessions; And we have acquired everything that we have desired*) — the architecture the rich-young-ruler-substance carried-out at his departure-sorrowful; 1 Enoch 94:8 names the rich-man's-internal-monologue substance (*let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses*) — the substance the rich-fool parable at Luke 12:16-21 will-name explicitly (*I will pull down my barns, and build greater*); 1 Enoch 98:10 names the *ye know no ransom* substance — the architecture the disciples' *who then can be saved?* at Matt 19:25 presupposes-the-failure-of (the inherited-substance that-had-associated-material-prosperity-with-the-Father's-blessing collapses against the Enochic and the King's warning); 1 Enoch 100:6 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the *riches shall not be able to save them* substance — the substance the King's-statement at Matt 19:26's *with men this is impossible; but with Elohim (God) all things are possible* lands. The framework reads the cluster as the Enochic wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of the King's-warning. The framework rules out: the Needle's-Eye-gate explanation (no historical-evidence at any period); the prosperity-gospel-collapse-of-Tanakh-substance (Avraham (Abraham)'s-wealth and Yitschaq (Isaac)'s-hundredfold and the Deuteronomy 28-blessings stand in the Tanakh-context where the heart-was-with-Yahuah, NOT as universal-equation of riches-equals-blessing); the universalist-reading the v.26 substance does NOT support (the substance is the Father-able-to-soften-the-heart-the-possessions-hold per Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27's new-heart substance + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:33's heart-Torah substance, NOT determinist-saving-of-all-rich-men-regardless-of-disposition). Grace is the door-home, the means-of-return-to-the-Father's-Way, NOT the cancellation-of-the-substance-the-Father-commands per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md.

title: Many be called, but few chosen — 1 Enoch 39 + 1 Enoch 48 + 2 Esdras 8's wisdom-stream witness to Matt 20:16's cause-and-effect-of-hearing
summary_md: Matt 20:16's closing-line of the laborers-parable — *so the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen* — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the cause-and-effect-of-hearing per Red Line #11. The framework reads the substance carefully — the substance is BOTH-AND, not EITHER-OR. The Reformed-monergistic-determinism that would collapse the substance into Father-unilaterally-chooses-without-disposition-walked is read-out by the cause-and-effect-architecture (the substance the citizen-walks is the substance-the-Father-knew-from-the-foundation, and the substance-walked is the substance-walked-by-the-citizen-who-is). The Arminian-libertarian-freedom that would collapse the substance into citizen-chooses-without-the-Father's-foreknowledge is also read-out (the hearing-reveals-what-was-already-true; the substance-of-disposition is the substance-the-Father-knew-from-the-foundation; the hearing-does-not-create the substance-of-disposition). The *many-called-but-few-chosen* substance is the seal of both substances at once — the broad-call going-out because the sheep-are-scattered, and the *chosen* (Greek *eklektoi*) walking-as-the-citizens-the-Father-has-known-from-before-the-foundation (Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8, 17:8; John 10:26-27's *ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep ... my sheep hear my voice*). Four moves: 1 Enoch 39:1 names the wisdom-stream articulation of the elect-and-holy-children-of-the-earth-who-behold-the-secrets-of-the-heaven substance — the *eklektoi* the King names at v.16 are the same elect-and-holy-children the wisdom-stream names; 1 Enoch 48:1 names the broad-fountain-the-thirsty-drink-from substance — the broad-proclamation-substance that reaches-the-many because the citizens are scattered-among-the-nations; 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 8:1 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the world-made-for-many-but-the-world-to-come-for-few substance; 2 Esdras 8:3 names the even-more-pointed *there be many created, but few shall be saved* — the wisdom-stream prefiguring the King's-own-mouth substance. The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream's direct corroboration of Red Line #11's cause-and-effect-of-hearing + post-harvest-sifting architecture — the harvest separates wheat-from-tares (Matt 13:30); the gathered-wheat then passes through a post-harvest-sifting (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 20:37-38; Matt 25:32; Luke 3:17); names get-blotted-out at the post-harvest-sifting for lawlessness; the warning is to wheat, not to tares. The *few* the parable names are the wheat-that-bears-fruit-and-is-not-blotted-out, not a Reformed-eternal-security-without-the-walking nor an Arminian-perfectability-by-effort.

title: The Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many — 1 Enoch's Son-of-Adam Parables (ch 46, 48, 62) + Testaments of the Twelve 94 + Sirach 3 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 20:25-28's chapter-pivot — the King's categorical-inversion *but it shall not be so among you ... whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister (diakonos); and whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant (doulos)* + the framework-major v.28 *even as the Son of Adam came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many* — read against the wisdom-stream and pseudepigraphal-stream articulation of the Son-of-Adam-lowly-on-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven + greatness-through-humility architecture. The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR per Red Line #12's Son-of-Adam-restoration and the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section of framework-deep.md. The King names himself explicitly as the Tanakh-Suffering-Servant of Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 53 and the *kofer*-ransom-substance of the Torah (Shemot (Exodus) 21:30; 30:12-13, 16; Bamidbar (Numbers) 35:31-33; Psalm 49:6-9; Daniel 9:24-27); the *many* (Greek *pollōn*) reads as the *rabbim* of the Servant-passage — the substantial-multitude the Father's-Book-of-Life from-the-foundation-of-the-world has named, neither the universalist-collapse nor the limited-atonement-restrictivism but the Three-Categories-architecture the framework reads across the gathering-arc. Five moves: 1 Enoch 46:3 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the Son-of-Adam-who-hath-righteousness — the named Son-of-Adam in the Parables-of-Enoch the gospels articulate at the gospel-pivot; 1 Enoch 48:2 names the Son-of-Adam-named-before-the-foundation-of-the-world substance — the substantial-ransom was determined by-the-Father from-before-the-foundation (per Hitgalut (Revelation) 13:8's *Lamb slain from the foundation of the world*); 1 Enoch 62:9 names the eschatological-judgment-and-vindication of the Son-of-Adam — the same Son-of-Adam who-walks-the-substantial-ransom at the first-coming will-walk the substantial-judgment at the second-coming; Testaments of the Twelve 94:5 (Testament of Benjamin) names THE direct extras-stream verbal-anchor for the lowly-on-earth-and-glorious-in-heaven substance — the kenotic-incarnational architecture the King articulates at v.28; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 3:18 names the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the greater-the-more-humble substance — the inverse-architecture the King names at vv.26-27's *whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister.* The framework reads the cluster as the wisdom-stream and pseudepigraphal-stream's direct corroboration of the Son-of-Adam-came-not-to-be-ministered-unto-but-to-minister-and-give-his-life-a-ransom-for-many architecture; the substance is the same-substance through-the-wisdom-stream and-through-the-King and-through-the-apostolic-witness (Philippians 2:6-11's *made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant*; 1 Timothy 2:5-6's *who gave himself a ransom (antilytron) for all*; Hebrews 9:11-15's *by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption*; 1 Peter 1:18-19's *redeemed ... with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ)*; Hitgalut (Revelation) 5:9's *thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to Elohim (God) by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation*). The framework reads the substance in continuity with the cross-opens-the-door-home-without-cancelling-the-curse-system architecture per the *Grace, the Way, the New Heart, and the Mercy of Depart* section — the cup-the-King-drinks opens-the-door-to-the-new-heart-substance the Spirit causes-the-disciple-to-walk-in (Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27; Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34); the cross does NOT cancel-the-Torah-substance the Spirit-causes-the-disciple-to-keep.

title: Leaves without fruit judged — Wisdom of Solomon 4's flourish-in-branches-for-a-time, Sirach 23:25's no-root-no-fruit, and 1 Enoch 89's consequences-on-the-scattered-flock
summary_md: Matt 21:18-22's cursed-fig-tree-substance — the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) walking the substantial-prophetic-action against the leaves-without-fruit substance the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership had-walked; the Tanakh-fig-tree-substance of Hosheia (Hosea) 9:10, Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 8:13, Yo'el (Joel) 1:7, and Mikhah (Micah) 7:1 carried-forward as the covenant-fruitfulness-substance the leadership-substance had-corrupted — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the unfruitful-branches-substance-judged architecture. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 4:4 names the wisdom-stream's direct verbal-anchor for the flourishing-in-branches-for-a-time-but-standing-not-last substance (*for though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out*); Wisdom of Solomon 4:5 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the imperfect-branches-broken-off-and-the-fruit-unprofitable substance (*the imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing*) — the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the substance the King-walks-against at the fig-tree-substance; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 23:25 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the no-root-and-no-fruit substance (*her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit*); 1 Enoch 89:35 names the Animal-Apocalypse's articulation of the consequences-on-the-scattered-flock-when-the-unfruitful-leadership-walks (*and the Lord of the sheep was silent, and the beasts and birds devoured the sheep, and the sheep were scattered*). The framework reads the cluster per the framework's system-not-people-posture — the substance the King-walks-against at the fig-tree-substance is the Pharisaic-Sadducean-leadership-substance the wisdom-stream-corpus and the Animal-Apocalypse-substance had-named the architecture-of; the substance is-NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically, per the same diagnostic the matt-13-tares, the matt-15-blind-leaders-of-the-blind, and the matt-23-seven-woes hold throughout the gospel. The framework reads the Tanakh-prophets' shepherd-substance — Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 34's *woe be to the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) that do feed themselves!* + Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 23's *woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture!* — in continuity with the King's-own-substance at John 10:11-16 (*I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep*) — the unfruitful-leadership-substance produces-the-scattered-flock; the King-substance comes-to-gather the scattered-substance the unfruitful-leadership had-scattered.

title: The wicked husbandmen — prophets slain, house desolate, corrupt shepherds judged, and the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) gathered as from the beginning (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
summary_md: Matt 21:33-46's FRAMEWORK-MAJOR parable-of-the-wicked-husbandmen — the Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 5:1-7 vineyard-of-Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) substance walked-out at the leadership-level (the husbandmen are the LEADERSHIP-substance, NOT the people-of-Yashar'el (Israel) categorically); the servants-substance is the prophets-substance the Tanakh names; the killing-and-stoning is the Tanakh-prophet-killing-pattern; the *last of all he sent unto them his son* substance is the King's-walking-toward-the-cross; the King citing Tehillim (Psalm) 118:22-23 *the stone which the builders rejected*; the chapter-pivot at v.43 — *the kingdom of Elohim (God) shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof* — the framework-MAJOR-substance for the kingdom-stewardship-transferred-from-the-current-leadership-stewards-of-Yahudah (Judah) to-the-bringing-forth-fruit-remnant-of-the-gathering-of-the-scattered-seed-of-both-houses-of-Yashar'el (Israel), with the Greek *ethnos* SINGULAR-not-plural locking the reading against the inherited-Christian-replacement-theology collapse — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulations of (a) the prophets-slain substance + (b) the house-desolate substance + (c) the corrupt-shepherds-judged substance + (d) the gather-all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov-as-from-the-beginning substance the v.43 framework-MAJOR-pivot walks-into. Four moves: 2 Esdras 1:32 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the servants-the-prophets-taken-and-slain substance (*I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands*) the parable walks-out at vv.34-36; 2 Esdras 1:33 names THE direct verbal-anchor for the house-desolate substance (*your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble*) the consequence-of-the-killing-of-the-Son at v.39 walks-into per the Olivet-discourse-substance at Matthew 24:1-2; 1 Enoch 89:45 names the Animal-Apocalypse's direct verbal-anchor for the leadership-judgment-substance (*the shepherds who had not fed the sheep were judged, and cast into the same fiery abyss with the beasts*) the *he will miserably destroy those wicked men* at v.41 walks-into; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:11 names THE direct wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the gather-all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov substance (*gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning*) the chapter-pivot at v.43 walks-into per Red Line #11's ingathering-of-the-paternal-blood-remnant-of-all-twelve-tribes architecture. The framework reads the v.43 *nation* (Greek *ethnos*, SINGULAR-not-plural) as the gathered-bringing-forth-fruit-remnant of the twelve-tribes-of-Ya'aqov the wisdom-stream-Sirach-36:11 substance had-prayed-the-Father-for, NOT the categorical-displacement of Yashar'el (Israel) by the church. The framework rules out THREE inherited readings of v.43: (1) the Christian-replacement-theology that-the-categorical-church-replaces-Yashar'el collapses the singular-*ethnos* against the wisdom-stream's-direct-naming of the substance as *all the tribes of Ya'aqov*; (2) the Hebrew-Roots-false-inclusion that-the-Torah-keeping-categorical-anyone replaces-the-current-leadership collapses the paternal-blood-substance the *tribes of Ya'aqov* names by-name-by-tribe per Red Line #3; (3) the Reformation-sola-fide-without-fruit that-the-bringing-forth-fruit is-incidental collapses the load-bearing-clause itself — the bringing-forth-fruit-substance is the Spirit-empowered-heart-Torah-walking substance per Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:31-34 + Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 36:26-27 + James 2:14-26's faith-without-works-is-dead substance.
